svg.title: Issue 3 — Page 8 — Panel 1: SCALE REVERSAL — workbench AS landscape, Theodore looming above cliff edge
svg.desc: Wide 24mm low angle FAIRY-SCALE PERSPECTIVE. Victorian workbench surface stretching like vast wooden plateau. Brass gears as boulders. Coiled mainspring as architectural structure. Steel file as long ridged bridge. Wood shavings as fallen logs. Steel thimble as dome the size of small building. Candle in holder is towering column of wax + flame, fire blazing furnace casting enormous warm light. Beyond bench cliff-edge a giant face rises — boy with wide hazel eyes like enormous saucers reflecting firelight, sandy hair, hands on bench edge like architectural structures. In foreground tiny lean figure in emerald metallic suit stands back partially to camera, weight on one leg, looking up at enormous boy — confident, surveying giant. Warm amber from candle-tower casts long shadows across bench terrain. Cool emerald glow from suit. The mundane made monumental.
